t: This is Haggerston School, a secondary school and sixth form on Weymouth Terrace in Hackney. The building is Grade II listed, which tells you it matters architecturally. It was built in 1964 to 65 and designed by Ernő Goldfinger, the Hungarian-British architect and furniture designer. He is celebrated as a modernist, and this school is one of his works. Look at it as a piece of mid-century design that still does its everyday job, with pupils coming and going as it has for decades.
